anthropic-2026-09.title: Anthropic 威胁报告 · 双语导读
anthropic-2026-09.description: Kimi 数据转发与交友骗局的中英摘要，附官方原文、页码和章节导航。由 Juju Radar 整理，非全文翻译。
anthropic-2026-09.report_title: Detecting and countering misuse of AI: September 2026

blocks.title: Kimi：数据去了哪里
blocks.en: Anthropic alleges that Moonshot routed Kimi users’ requests through Claude, including surveillance material and corporate credentials. This does not establish that the material was classified.
blocks.zh: Anthropic 指称，Moonshot 将 Kimi 用户请求转交 Claude，其中涉及监控资料和企业凭据。这不足以认定相关材料属于国家秘密。

blocks.title: 交友骗局：聊天与付费
blocks.en: The report describes dating apps concealing AI personas while charging for continued interaction. It provides neither victims’ ages nor a verified total financial loss.
blocks.zh: 报告描述了一批隐瞒 AI 身份、诱导用户付费聊天的交友应用，未披露受害者年龄及经核实的损失总额。
